mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE login_id = '__system__' AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_forecast_run ( client_request_id, schedule_key, trigger_type, base_date, run_status, current_stage, started_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{clientRequestId}, #{scheduleKey}, 'SCHEDULED', #{baseDate}, 'RUNNING', 'EXPORTING', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{userId}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM demand_forecast_run WHERE client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM demand_forecast_run WHERE run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = 'AZURE_POLLING' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY forecast_run_id

SELECT * FROM demand_forecast_run WHERE run_status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{timeoutSeconds}, 'SECOND') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY forecast_run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET export_job_execution_id = #{jobExecutionId}, input_blob_url = #{blobUrl}, current_stage = 'AZURE_SUBMITTING', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage IN ('EXPORTING', 'UPLOADING')

UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET azure_job_id = #{azureJobId}, submitted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, last_polled_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, current_stage = 'AZURE_POLLING', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = 'AZURE_SUBMITTING'

UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET last_polled_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = 'AZURE_POLLING'

UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET current_stage = 'IMPORT_REQUESTING', import_requested_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = 'AZURE_POLLING'

UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET run_status = 'FAILED', current_stage = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING'
